title: Invalid apikey format
help: Apikey must be 32 characters. Copy the read and write apikey from the emoncms account page.

title: Serial port $1 not available
help: No device found at $1. Check the device is connected, or remove the interfacer if it is no longer used. EmonHub retries every 10 seconds.

title: Device communication error
help: Check the serial port and baud rate settings.

title: Device did not confirm setting $1
help: Device did not reply when emonhub sent this setting. Check the firmware version supports it.

match: No radio packets received in last (\d+) seconds
title: No radio packets for $1 s, radio restarted
help: Radio nodes may be out of range, switched off or have flat batteries. With few nodes and long send intervals, occasional restarts are normal.

match: Could not connect to RFM?69 module|Error initiali[sz]ing RFM?69|Cannot connect to RF69|Timed out waiting for RF69
title: Radio module not responding
help: Check the radio module is fitted and the selPin, resetPin and interruptPin settings match the hardware.

title: Radio running in polling mode
help: Interrupt setup failed so the radio is polled. Data is still received.

title: Radio read error
help: Occasional errors are harmless. Frequent errors suggest a hardware or wiring fault.

match: Discarded RX frame not in nodelist, node:(\d+)
title: Frames from unknown node $1 discarded
help: Node $1 is not listed in [nodes] and autoconf is off. Add the node, or ignore if it belongs to a neighbour.

match: RX data length: \d+ is not valid for datacodes?
title: Frame length does not match datacodes
help: Datacodes for this node in [nodes] do not match the frame the node sends. Check the node firmware and the node definition.

match: Discarded RX frame '(string too short|non-numerical content)'
title: Corrupt frames discarded
help: Occasional corrupt frames are normal on radio links. Frequent occurrence suggests interference or a wiring fault.

match: Unable to decode as values incorrect for datacode
title: Frames could not be decoded
help: Check the datacodes for this node in [nodes].

title: Not authorised by $1
help: Check the apikey setting. Data is kept and sent once this is fixed.

title: Could not reach server
help: Network, DNS or server problem. Data is kept in the buffer and sent when the server is reachable.

title: Rate limited by $1
help: Server asked emonhub to slow down. Data is kept. Consider a longer interval.

title: Server error from $2
help: Server is having problems. Data is kept and retried.

title: Unexpected reply from $1 (HTTP $2)
help: Reply was not from emoncms. Check the url setting, or a proxy or captive portal on the network.

title: Frames rejected as invalid by $1
help: Emoncms refused the data, and these frames are discarded.

title: Batch too large for $1
help: Reduce the batchsize setting. Data is kept.

match: dropped \d+ value\(s\) and \d+ frame\(s\)|unable to encode as JSON
title: Invalid values dropped before sending
help: Some values could not be encoded, for example NaN. Remaining data was sent.

title: $1 buffer full, oldest data deleted
help: Data could not be sent for a long time and the oldest data has been lost. Look for send errors above.

title: $1 buffer recovered
help: Sending resumed after the buffer was full.

match: posting to (\S+) resumed after (\d+) failed attempts
title: Posting to $1 resumed
help: Sending recovered after failed attempts.

title: MQTT connection refused: $1
help: Check mqtt_host, mqtt_port, mqtt_user and mqtt_passwd.

title: Could not connect to MQTT server
help: Check the MQTT broker (mosquitto) is running and mqtt_host is correct.

title: MQTT disconnected
help: Connection to the MQTT broker was lost. EmonHub reconnects automatically.

match: Failed to configure TLS for MQTT
title: MQTT TLS setup failed
help: Check the TLS settings and certificate paths.

match: Could not (find|connect to) Modbus device|Not connected to modbus device|modbus(TCP)? connection failed|Could not read (register|all registers)|Connection failed on read of register
title: Modbus device not responding
help: Check the device is powered, wiring or network address, device address and baud rate.

title: Modbus register settings mismatch
help: Each register needs a matching datatype and function code.

match: Could not (find MBUS device|connect to MBUS serial|write to MBUS serial port)|could not read from serial port
title: M-Bus device not responding
help: Check the M-Bus adapter is connected and the meter address and baud rate.

match: Could not read from SDM120|Not connected to SDM120
title: SDM120 meter not responding
help: Check the Modbus adapter, wiring and meter address.

title: Shelly $1 authentication failed
help: Check the password setting for the Shelly device at $2.

title: Shelly $1 communication problem
help: Check the Shelly device at $2 is powered and reachable on the network.

match: Please install the RPi GPIO|spidev or RPi\.GPIO not available|PYMODBUS NOT PRESENT|bluepy module btle not found
title: Required Python module missing
help: Install the module named in the log line, then restart emonhub.

title: Invalid value for $2 setting $3
help: Value '$1' was not accepted. Check the setting in the configuration.

match: In interfacer set '(.+)' is not a valid setting for (\S+): (\S+)
title: Invalid value for $2 setting $3
help: Value '$1' was not accepted. Check the setting in the configuration.

title: Interfacer $2 could not be created
help: Check the Type and init_settings of this interfacer.

title: Settings for $1 could not be applied
help: Check the runtimesettings of this interfacer.

title: Unexpected error in $1
help: Interfacer hit an error it did not handle. Download the log for the full traceback.

title: Interfacer $1 stopped and was restarted
help: Look for an unexpected error from this interfacer just before.

match: Configuration file missing section|Could not get settings|Couldn't get settings
title: Configuration could not be read
help: Check emonhub.conf for syntax errors.

title: Invalid loglevel
help: Use DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR or CRITICAL.
